 An overview of this role
As a Senior Product Manager for Data Integrations, you'll help GitLab's analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) agents see beyond the data held in GitLab. You'll decide which external systems connect to the Data Insights Platform and Orbit, which integrations come first, and how their data fits into shared models.
Engineering teams plan work, track incidents, monitor production, and manage security findings across different tools. Your challenge is to bring that context together with GitLab's code, merge requests, pipelines, deployments, and vulnerabilities. You'll shape a consistent approach that gives customers a trustworthy picture they can query, report on, and use with agents, rather than another set of disconnected data sources.
This role is based in Bangalore, India. You'll work from home and come to the Bangalore office when needed for business or team activities. You should be based in Bangalore or willing to relocate there.
What you'll do
 Set integration priorities using evidence from customers, field teams, and other product managers to identify the biggest gaps in context.
 Shape how external data maps into GitLab's shared data models, including the extract, transform, and load (ETL) approach and the transformations needed to make sources work together.
 Define the customer problems and user groups each integration serves. Partner with engineering to agree on the intended experience, trade-offs, and delivery sequence.
 Translate product decisions into a clear backlog of epics and issues for engineering.
 Define telemetry and adoption signals to understand whether connected data helps customers answer new questions, and use those findings to guide priorities.
 Help shape integration pricing and packaging as the product area matures.
 Use AI coding agents and GitLab to explore data, prototype integrations, and document the intended experience.
 What you'll bring
 Product management experience, with the ability to connect customer needs to priorities and make trade-offs with incomplete information.
 Strong knowledge of the software development and operations (DevOps)

Description
 Amazon Australia helps Australian businesses of every size reach millions of customers and grow their business. The AU 3P Seller Services team recruits local businesses to sell in the Amazon.com.au store and supports their success and growth. Much of that growth is delivered through Account Managers (AMs), who manage seller portfolios, solve problems for sellers and help them adopt the programs that grow their business. Our vision is for every AM to spend their time on the work that moves sellers forward, backed by tools that do the rest.
The AM Tools Product team builds and launches the products AMs use every day: seller insights, portfolio prioritisation, escalation tracking, reporting and AI assistants. We work with Amazon's global seller services, tech and AI teams to bring the right capabilities to Australian AMs, and we build our own where local needs call for it. As AI becomes central to how AMs work, we are building AI-powered tools that automate routine work, surface the next best action for each seller, and let one AM support more sellers with more impact.
We are looking for a Product Manager to own AM tools end to end, from discovery through launch, adoption and measured impact. The ideal candidate knows how AMs actually spend their day, spots where time is lost, studies working models to find patterns, and designs tools that remove that friction. They earn trust with AMs and their leaders, drive adoption through training, enablement and change management, and are accountable for whether a tool changes how the team works and what sellers achieve. They work across engineering, data science, BI, UX, and AM and operations leadership in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
You will own a product area end to end and see its impact directly in how AMs work and how sellers grow. You will build hands-on experience with GenAI and agentic products, from model evaluation to responsible AI practices, alongside data scientists and ML engineers. You will work with senior leaders in AU 3P and with global seller services and AI teams, which builds your influence and network across Amazon. Amazon also supports your development through product management training, mentoring from senior PMs, and room to take on a larger scope as the AM tools portfolio grows.
Key job responsibilities
 Define and own the AM tools strategy and roadmap across seller segments and the AM workflow, prioritising the investments that return the most AM time and seller growth.
 Build and launch AI-powered tools with partner teams, including GenAI assistants, automated seller insights and agentic workflows. Write clear requirements that balance technical feasibility, user needs, business impact and responsible AI standards.

 Partner with global AM tooling, seller services and AI teams to reuse existing solutions, shape their roadmaps for Australian needs, and manage leadership communication on solution reviews and impact.

Description
 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Serverless Compute team. Our team owns the products that make it radically easier for builders to build scalable, reliable, and intelligent cloud applications without managing infrastructure. Our portfolio includes some of the most widely adopted services in cloud computing: AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions, Amazon EventBridge, and AWS Elastic Beanstalk. Together, these services power millions of customer workloads, from event-driven architectures and workflow orchestration to full application deployment. Our latest innovations are defining how customers build complex, multi-step, AI-native applications on AWS, including durable execution for AI agents and next-generation compute primitives.
We're looking for a product manager who is passionate about solving customer problems and has demonstrated success in turning ambiguous customer needs into successful products. In this role, you will help evolve our serverless services by delivering new capabilities and intuitive developer experiences that make it easier to build applications without becoming an expert in distributed systems. If you're excited by cloud computing and have a deep-rooted passion for the evolution of computing and application development platforms, we want to talk to you.
As a Senior Product Manager, you will be a critical part of the PM organization that owns the business model and P&L, prioritization of the product roadmap, customer segmentation and pricing, and demand generation for impactful new products. You will work across engineering, business development, and marketing leads to set strategy, define the product, and make high-judgment trade-offs between features and time-to-market. You will partner with technical leaders to ensure the programming model, scalability and reliability promises, and developer experience delight our customers. You will also play a key role in hiring additional team members and helping set the vision and culture of this business.
The breadth of this role is what makes it unique. Depending on your interests and strengths, you could find yourself working on event-driven architectures that connect and integrate cloud-native systems at scale, workflow orchestration and durable execution for AI agents and distributed applications, or developer experiences that make building, deploying, and governing serverless applications effortless.
Key job responsibilities
 Define and prioritize the product roadmap for your service area, translating customer needs into clear requirements and making transparent trade-offs between scope, quality, and delivery timelines.
 Drive product development end-to-end across engineering, operations, business development, and marketing — from authoring business requirements and functional specifications through design, implementation, and launch.
 Engage directly with external customers and partners to understand their technical challenges, validate assumptions through usability studies and market research, and turn those insights into product decisions that improve adoption and satisfaction.
 Evaluate industry innovations, technology platforms, and generative AI capabilities to identify opportunities that strengthen our serverless portfolio and keep it ahead of customer expectations.
 Mentor and coach other product managers on best practices while actively participating in recruiting efforts to grow the team.
